BatchSizingItem.title: BatchSizingItem

description:
Request for batch sizing - multiple sizing requests in one API call.

Each item is processed independently. If fail_fast=True, processing stops
on first error. Otherwise, all items are processed and errors are collected.

batch_id.description: Optional batch identifier. If None, server generates UUID.
batch_id.title: Batch Id

fail_fast.description: If True, stop processing on first error. If False (default), process all items and collect errors.
fail_fast.title: Fail Fast

items.description: List of sizing items to process. Max 100 items per batch.
items.title: Items

title: BatchSizingRequest
